runtime.pinned_lane_requirement: The supported 1.21.1/NeoForge 21.1.262 tuple is staged/working on this device. NeoForge 21.1.264 is an optional future patch, not a blocker. The 1.20.1/Fabric legacy lane and the 26.3/Fabric future lane remain NOT RUN.

target_runtime.role: delivery tuple; supported and staged/working on this device

optional_future_patch.status: NOT RUN; not a delivery target or release blocker

stable_fallback.pairing_rule: Iris 1.8.12 declares Sodium 0.6.13 as its required dependency; Sodium 0.8.13 is not its declared pairing.

target_runtime.evidence_scope: The runtime block above is the game-process reference for the supported NeoForge 21.1.262 tuple. NeoForge 21.1.264 is an optional future patch.

pins.note: Runtime and shaderpack lock hashes match the current lock files. The remaining hashes identify the evidence tuple; they are not a release lock.

evidence.note: Game-process smoke and staged ACT/WSR results; logs and captures are referenced there and stored outside Git.

hard_gates.requirement: 8 x 8 x 8 local group, at least 512 total invocations
hard_gates.evidence: capability probe compute_512_invocations value 1298; wrapper_probe compute_512 value 0x512
capability probe image value 42; wrapper_probe vertex_image_store

hard_gates.requirement: integer 3D image formats used by ACT/WSR
hard_gates.evidence: ESSL rejects r8ui/r16ui layout qualifiers; r32ui substitution writes and reads back
hard_gates.note: Wrapper r32ui backing is staged. Full r8ui/r16ui lowering is not implemented; do not claim support.

hard_gates.requirement: 50,855,936-byte storage buffer, access near the end
hard_gates.evidence: WSR 128 water and room scenes; log mclo.gs/adG0NiA

hard_gates.requirement: 114,229,248-byte storage buffer, access near the end

hard_gates.evidence: MAX_SHADER_STORAGE_BLOCK_SIZE is 134,217,728 bytes; allocation/map succeed but the shader cannot write the last element
hard_gates.note: Extra system RAM does not repair a smaller accessible storage-block range. This blocks Ultra WSR 256 on X1E, but that profile is optional/future X2E only and is not required for the X1E release.

hard_gates.evidence: raw FBO incomplete 36054; wrapper RGB8_SNORM backing is PASS staged
hard_gates.note: The wrapper workaround is evidenced; the raw provider contract remains a failure.

hard_gates.requirement: same provider binary in the probe and game process
hard_gates.note: F3 and logs show ANGLE/Adreno in game, but library-path identity has not been compared.

hard_gates.requirement: Minecraft 1.21.1 / Java 21 (java-runtime-delta) / NeoForge 21.1.262 / Iris 1.8.14-beta.1 / Sodium 0.8.13 startup
hard_gates.note: This is the supported X1E tuple. The 1.21.1 world loaded and rendered the original pack and saved/quit to title. NeoForge 21.1.264 is an optional future patch, not a release blocker.
Future/experimental lane; Android SDL/LWJGL closure and function-provider bridge are unresolved.

hard_gates.requirement: Minecraft 1.20.1 / Java 17 / Fabric / Iris 1.7.6 / Sodium 0.5.12-beta.2 startup
hard_gates.note: The observed 1.21.1/NeoForge smoke is not this lane.

hard_gates.requirement: effect-by-effect standard fidelity against a desktop GL reference
hard_gates.note: High initializes without fallback; named effects are not isolated.

hard_gates.requirement: sustained 30 FPS at 1920 x 1200 with the selected standard preset
hard_gates.note: Historical spot checks were 20-22 FPS at 2880 x 1585, not a controlled 1920 x 1200 run.

hard_gates.requirement: resize, focus, fullscreen, suspend/resume and context recovery

hard_gates.note: No retail X2E Googlebook has been measured.

test_results.name: copy_image_subdata_depth

test_results.detail: Reference staged pass on the supported NeoForge 21.1.262 tuple: 1.21.1 world loaded and rendered with the original pack, image units 0-3 distinct, save/quit to title succeeded; captures 2026-10-19-1.21.1-neoforge-21.1.262-{world,title}.png. Effect-by-effect fidelity, performance and lifecycle remain open; 21.1.264 is optional future work

test_results.name: standard_effect_matrix
test_results.detail: No PBR, shadow, bloom, TAA/history or SSR isolation

test_results.name: advanced_effect_matrix
test_results.detail: ACT 192 and WSR 128 staged and required; WSR 192 optional staged headroom; WSR 256 optional/future X2E and blocked on X1E; player reflections and independent compute pack not run

not_qualified_reason: The supported 21.1.262 tuple is staged/working and the device has provider and staged pack evidence, but no pack has passed effect-by-effect fidelity, and performance, lifecycle and recovery gates are unmeasured. NeoForge 21.1.264 is optional future work; WSR 256 is optional/future X2E, not an X1E release blocker.
